commands:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=$(pwd)
BASE=1f79d3b74f28c1d3123a57fbd5e4f4a9b9a1fd78
BRANCH=work/photomap-straighten-20260912
FILE=frontend/src/components/map/PlaceMap.tsx
cleanup() { git -C "$ROOT" restore --staged --worktree -- "$FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; ./scripts/devctl.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT
git fetch origin "$BRANCH"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$BASE"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/$BRANCH)" = "$BASE"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
cd frontend
npm run build >/tmp/photomap-pinned-baseline-build.log
BASE_GZIP=$(python3 -c 'import glob,gzip; p=glob.glob("dist/assets/public-map-*.js"); assert len(p)==1; print(len(gzip.compress(open(p[0],"rb").read(),mtime=0)))')
cd ..
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('frontend/src/components/map/PlaceMap.tsx')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";', 'import { lazy, Suspense, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";', 1)
s=s.replace('import { PinnedMediaBoard, type PinnedMediaPlaceProjector } from "./PinnedMediaBoard";', 'import type { PinnedMediaPlaceProjector } from "./PinnedMediaBoard";', 1)
anchor='const EMPTY_PLACE_GALLERY_ITEMS: PlaceMapVisualItem[] = [];'
replacement=anchor+'\nconst LazyPinnedMediaBoard = lazy(() =>\n  import("./PinnedMediaBoard").then(({ PinnedMediaBoard }) => ({ default: PinnedMediaBoard })),\n);'
if anchor not in s:
    raise SystemExit('Pinned media lazy anchor missing')
s=s.replace(anchor,replacement,1)
old='''      {showPinnedMedia ? (
        <PinnedMediaBoard
          cards={cards}
          notice={notice}
          onBringToFront={onBringToFront}
          onLayoutChange={onLayoutChange}
          onMediaSizeChange={onMediaSizeChange}
          onRemove={onRemove}
          projectPlacePoint={projectPlacePoint}
        />
      ) : null}'''
new='''      {showPinnedMedia && (cards.length > 0 || notice) ? (
        <Suspense fallback={null}>
          <LazyPinnedMediaBoard
            cards={cards}
            notice={notice}
            onBringToFront={onBringToFront}
            onLayoutChange={onLayoutChange}
            onMediaSizeChange={onMediaSizeChange}
            onRemove={onRemove}
            projectPlacePoint={projectPlacePoint}
          />
        </Suspense>
      ) : null}'''
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('PinnedMediaBoard render anchor missing')
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
cd frontend
npm run lint
npm run build >/tmp/photomap-pinned-lazy-build.log
AFTER_GZIP=$(python3 -c 'import glob,gzip; p=glob.glob("dist/assets/public-map-*.js"); assert len(p)==1; print(len(gzip.compress(open(p[0],"rb").read(),mtime=0)))')
BOARD_CHUNKS=$(find dist/assets -maxdepth 1 -name 'PinnedMediaBoard-*.js' -print)
SAVED=$((BASE_GZIP-AFTER_GZIP))
echo "baseline_public_map_gzip=$BASE_GZIP"
echo "after_public_map_gzip=$AFTER_GZIP"
echo "saved_gzip=$SAVED"
echo "board_chunks=$BOARD_CHUNKS"
test -n "$BOARD_CHUNKS"
test "$SAVED" -ge 1500
cd ..
VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-pinned-lazy-e2e-XXXXXX)
python3 -m venv "$VENV"
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt
cd frontend
PYTHON="$VENV/bin/python" npm run test:e2e -- e2e/visual/map.spec.ts e2e/smoke/public-map.spec.ts --project=chromium --grep-invert 'visual:'
cd ..
rm -rf "$VENV"
git diff --check
git add "$FILE"
test "$(git diff --cached --name-only)" = "$FILE"
git commit -m 'Lazy load pinned media board'
git push origin HEAD:"$BRANCH"
trap - EXIT
./scripts/devctl.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
printf 'published_sha='
git rev-parse HEAD
